title: Lens-phase calibration model
calibration_rule: Choose quadratic phase curvature so centered OAM mode ell receives omega^(ell^2). With labels ell=-1,0,+1 mapped to q=2,0,1, this equals qutrit S: omega^(q^2).
interpretation: The S/lens row can be made exact at the finite phase-signature level on the centered OAM basis. Both qutrit S and centered quadratic lens phase have omega-exponent signature [1,0,1].
honesty_boundary: Exact discrete phase-signature match. Physical lens still needs mode-overlap and aberration calibration in the lab.
